subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 13, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has become even more robust with the latest enhancements, including per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, significantly improving the reliability of our ISO build process, and you can learn more about our current workflow at https://acreetionos.org/. 

Development
The recent updates to our CI pipeline are a direct result of our community's tireless efforts to refine and stabilize our workflow, ensuring that AcreetionOS remains a cutting-edge, Arch-based Linux distribution, and our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html is being updated to reflect these changes. The Emacs 31.1 release has also been making waves in our community, with many exploring its new features and capabilities.

Community
Our community has been actively discussing the latest security updates, including those for AlmaLinux and the stable kernel set, and you can find more information about our security posture on our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html. We're also seeing interesting developments in the broader Linux ecosystem, and our community is eager to explore and discuss these advancements.

Tip of the day
If you're looking to get started with AcreetionOS, be sure to check out our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html for the latest information on our ISO builds, and don't forget to review our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html to stay up-to-date on the latest developments in our project.
